knowledge_graph.title: Disease
knowledge_graph.description: A disease is a particular abnormal condition that adversely affects the structure or function of all or part of an organism and is not immediately due to any external injury. Diseases are often known to be medical conditions that are associated with specific signs and symptoms.

text_blocks.snippet: An illness is a state of poor health characterized by:
snippet_highlighted_words: a state of poor health characterized by:

list.snippet: Physical or mental discomfort: Symptoms such as pain, fatigue, fever, or changes in mood.
Impaired functioning: Difficulty performing daily activities or work.
Deviation from normal health: A departure from the expected state of well-being.

text_blocks.snippet: Illnesses can be caused by a variety of factors, including:

list.snippet: Infections: Caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites.
Injuries: Physical trauma or damage to the body.
Chronic conditions: Long-term health conditions that require ongoing management, such as diabetes or heart disease.

definitions: a disease or period of sickness affecting the body or mind.
examples: he died after a long illness
